fidelity: F2a — Thevenin ECM (1/2-RC) + Coulomb SOC + Si hysteresis + thermal ODE
source: Plett (2015) Battery Management Systems Vol. 2 (ESC/ECM + one-state hysteresis); Hu et al. (2012) J. Power Sources 198, 359 (Thevenin n-RC comparison); McDowell et al. (2013) Adv. Mater. 25, 4966 (Si swelling); Obrovac & Christensen (2004) Electrochem. Solid-State Lett. 7, A93 (Si lithiation/delithiation OCV hysteresis); Bernardi et al. (1985) J. Electrochem. Soc. 132, 5 (lumped thermal energy balance)

unit.name: Si/NMC pouch cell (10% Si blend anode) — Thevenin ECM physics-lumped

capacity_ref.note: Nominal capacity at T_ref; elevated vs pure graphite due to Si (3579 mAh/g vs 372 mAh/g graphite). McDowell et al. (2013)

R0_ref.note: Series ohmic resistance at T_ref; Plett (2015) ESC R0

R1_ref.note: Fast RC charge-transfer resistance at T_ref

R2_ref.note: Slow RC diffusion resistance at T_ref

C2.note: Slow RC capacitance, tau2=R2*C2~720 s (Si solid-state diffusion is slow)

M_hyst.note: Max hysteresis voltage envelope; large for Si (lithiation/delithiation OCV split ~50-120 mV). Obrovac & Christensen (2004)

gamma_hyst.note: Hysteresis approach rate vs charge throughput; Plett (2015) one-state hysteresis

n_rc.note: Number of RC pairs (1 or 2). Hu et al. (2012)

eta_coulombic.note: Coulombic efficiency on charge; <1 due to Si SEI re-formation each cycle

E_a.note: Arrhenius activation energy for all resistances; elevated by Si SEI cracking. Lundqvist et al. (2021) J. Electrochem. Soc. 168, 060522

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic coefficient; Si plateau (~0.4 V vs Li) makes it less negative than graphite/NMC. Geng et al. (2020) J. Electrochem. Soc. 167, 090504

cp_cell.note: Lumped cell specific heat. Bernardi et al. (1985)

hA_cell.note: Convective heat-transfer coefficient * surface area to ambient

swelling_coeff.note: Fractional electrode thickness change at full lithiation; Si swells up to ~280-300% (cell-level blend ~10-30%). McDowell et al. (2013)

ocv_charge_coefficients.description: OCV_lithiation(SOC) (charge branch) = sum a_i*SOC^i, i=0..5. Upper of the hysteresis envelope.
ocv_charge_coefficients.source: Si/NMC lithiation OCV; NMC cathode dominates shape, Si anode plateau offsets it upward on charge. Obrovac & Christensen (2004); Plett (2015)

ocv_discharge_coefficients.description: OCV_delithiation(SOC) (discharge branch) = sum a_i*SOC^i, i=0..5. Lower of the hysteresis envelope.
ocv_discharge_coefficients.source: Si/NMC delithiation OCV; sits below charge branch by the Si hysteresis gap. Obrovac & Christensen (2004)
